source_evidence: Player exact 'These terms are acceptable. And I'll take the boots of elven kind, negotiated for price of course.' V accepts negotiated Defense of Caereth contract exactly as offered: maximum2500gp reserved by guild, 833gp for safe civilians/functioning meeting and1667gp for ending coercive hold, guild-funded appraisal and merchant/craft/magic broker introductions, written guild endorsement of V/House Vaishnavi and Assembly introductions on successful completion. No signing advance, no extra items guaranteed, no political pledge. Organizer expects V tomorrow after palace business and can arrange access to guild records and quartermaster before late-afternoon meeting. V then authorizes purchase of actual Quiet Heel Bootworks consigned original Boots of Elvenkind at negotiated price, stock owner asks290gp. Predeclared thresholds below13=290,13–17=275,18–22=260,23+=245gp. Mara helps negotiate; Cirren casts at-will Guidance before check, concentration ends, no slot. Actual visible Python receipt batch ab31dee67f966edc9d577c906abcd22c: advantage d20 faces20,11 choose20 +Persuasion6 +attuned Luckstone1 +Guidance d4 face1 =28, top tier245gp (45gp discount); natural20 skill check not automatic success. Cobbler accepts245 and transfers original boots, V pays once and wears, personal purse383gp4sp6cp (38346cp)→138gp4sp6cp (13846cp). Stock1→0 SOLD, no replacement. Item 2014 DMG Boots of Elvenkind: no attunement, soundless steps and advantage on Dexterity Stealth checks relying on moving silently, not all Stealth/Hide checks. No extra item or superiority/psi/MP spent. Per earlier explicit itinerary, party returns to Elara's Caereth residence and enjoys celebratory hosted dinner, household tends horses, no packed supply deduction, no public disclosure or extra expenditures. No night/rest completion or palace confirmation fabricated. D314~21:30 at Elara's Caereth city residence after accepted Defense of Caereth contract and purchase of original Boots of Elvenkind, celebratory dinner completed as previously requested, no overnight yet. Guild 2500gp capped milestones833+1667, appraisal and merchant/broker introductions, written endorsement and Assembly introductions on successful completion; no advance, earned payments or benefits yet. Organizer expects party D315 after palace business, late-afternoon meeting, offers records/quartermaster access. Original Quiet Heel Bootworks consigned Boots of Elvenkind purchased at245gp after actual Persuasion advantage 20/11 +7 +Guidance1=28; V purse383gp4sp6cp→138gp4sp6cp, stock1→0, V wears boots, no attunement, footsteps silent and advantage on Stealth relying on silent movement only, not universal Hide success. No class resource spent. All party HP/resources full, V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 attuned cloak+Luckstone2/3, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 full, Mara/Elara/4 horses healthy; food21/feed28 unchanged, rest3/6 (no night yet), PixieDust1, peryton specimens coach, all original evidence and compact custody unchanged. Palace audience requested, appointment not yet confirmed; no official accusation/evidence handoff. Elara covers hosted dinner and ordinary house hospitality, no V expense. Marriage recognized in Crownsunder, alliance memorandum reply pending. V dice delegated until stop. Next V decision before overnight or continue to morning palace business.
